resources.name: Integral Care – Veterans Mental Health Services
resources.description: Get low-cost or free help for stress, sadness, trauma, or other mental health needs. This program focuses on veterans, active duty, and their families in Travis County. They offer someone to talk to, treatment for post-traumatic stress (strong stress after scary events), and help with drug or alcohol problems. Staff can help with safety plans, medicine support, and finding other places that can help. You can call any time if you are in crisis or feel unsafe. Ask about walk-in times and what papers you need. They can help even if you have low income or no insurance.

resources.availability_status: Open for new clients - call first for a mental health check-up

resources.name: VA Austin Outpatient Clinic (Department of Veterans Affairs)

Tell them if you feel unsafe or very upset so they know it is urgent.

resources.name: Texas Rx Card (Free Prescription Discount Program)

Check the website or call to see which pharmacies near you take the card.

resources.description: Get help if an older adult is hurt, neglected, or taken advantage of for money. You can report abuse, neglect, or financial harm, even if family is involved. resources.name: Texas Adult Protective Services (APS)
resources.description: Get help if someone is hurting you, taking your money, or not caring for you. APS protects older adults and adults with disabilities from abuse, neglect, and money harm. You can make a report for yourself or for someone else. They can visit, check if you are safe, and help stop the harm. They can work with police and lawyers if needed. They can also help you find other local help. This help is for people age 65 or older, or adults with disabilities, in Texas. If you are in danger right now, call 911 first.
resources.availability_status: 24/7 hotline for reports of abuse, neglect, or financial harm
resources.source: Verified via Texas Health and Human Services official APS information

resources.name: Texas Legal Services Center – Legal Hotline for Texans
resources.description: Get free legal help by phone if you are age 60 or older in Texas. Lawyers can explain your rights about money harm, power of attorney, wills, and safety. They can help you plan how to protect your money and home. They can help you write simple legal papers. They can tell you what to do next and if you need a local lawyer. This help is by phone, so you do not have to travel. You may need to leave a message if they are busy. This is not an emergency line. Call 911 if you are in danger.
